entries.label: Identity confirmed

how_to.menu: Admission tab: Ask name and date of birth, Read wristband (tablet), Open notes, then Confirm identity.

voice.text: Ask the patient to say their full name and date of birth, then compare it with the wristband and the notes.
voice.example: Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?

entries.explanation: Two identifiers must agree before anything else is done.

entries.label: Allergies asked

how_to.menu: Admission tab: Ask about allergies.

voice.text: Ask about allergies, and what happened when the patient had one.
voice.example: Do you have any allergies, and what happened when you had a reaction?

entries.explanation: An unrecorded allergy is a common avoidable harm.

entries.label: Reason for admission asked

how_to.menu: Admission tab: Ask why she is here.

voice.text: Ask the patient what operation they are here for.
voice.example: What operation are you here for today?

entries.explanation: The patient's own account must match the booking.

entries.label: Responsible adult asked

how_to.menu: Admission tab: Ask about home support.

voice.text: Check that an adult can take the patient home and stay with them for 24 hours.
voice.example: Is there an adult who can take you home and stay with you tonight?

entries.explanation: Day-case discharge needs a responsible adult.

entries.label: Fasting checked

how_to.menu: Ask tab: Last food, then Last drink.

voice.text: Ask when the patient last ate and last drank, and compare with the time of anaesthesia.
voice.example: When did you last eat, and when did you last drink?

entries.explanation: Fasting times are compared with the time of anaesthesia.

entries.label: Permission asked before examining

how_to.menu: Assess tab: Ask permission to examine (and Offer a chaperone).

voice.text: Ask the patient's permission before you examine them (offer a chaperone if the hospital requires one).
voice.example: May I examine you now? I can ask a chaperone to be present.

entries.explanation: Permission is asked before touching the patient.

entries.label: Patient examined

how_to.menu: Assess tab: Examine, region by region, starting away from the painful area.

voice.text: Examine the patient, starting away from the area that hurts.
voice.example: I would like to examine your abdomen now.

entries.explanation: The examination findings feed the problem list.

entries.label: Airway checked

how_to.menu: Assess tab: Airway check.

voice.text: Check the airway: mouth opening, Mallampati, neck movement and thyromental distance.
voice.example: Please open your mouth wide and move your neck for me.

entries.explanation: The airway is checked before anaesthesia.

entries.label: ASA grade proposed

how_to.menu: Assess tab: ASA grade.

voice.text: Propose an ASA grade for the patient on the Assess tab.
voice.example: I propose an ASA grade for this patient.

entries.explanation: The grade summarises fitness for anaesthesia.

entries.label: Clot and bleeding risk form completed

how_to.menu: Assess tab: VTE risk, every item of the form.

voice.text: Answer every item of the clot and bleeding risk form.
voice.example: Let me complete the clot and bleeding risk form.

entries.explanation: The form is complete only when every item is answered.

entries.label: Anaesthetist called

how_to.menu: Assess tab: Ask the anaesthetist to review, then present the summary.

voice.text: Call the anaesthetist and present the summary.
voice.example: Please call the anaesthetist; I will present the summary.

entries.explanation: The anaesthetist reviews a clear summary.

entries.label: Anaesthetic plan agreed

how_to.menu: Assess tab: Ask the anaesthetist to review, then agree the plan.

voice.text: Agree the anaesthetic plan with the anaesthetist.
voice.example: Let us agree the anaesthetic plan.

entries.explanation: The plan is agreed with the anaesthetist, not decided alone.

entries.label: Readiness decision made

how_to.menu: Assess tab: Ready for theatre?, then choose the decision.

voice.text: Choose: proceed, optimise, more tests, review or postpone.
voice.example: I have made my readiness decision.

entries.explanation: The decision follows the problems found.

entries.label: The tests this patient needs are ordered

how_to.menu: Orders tab: Order a test, only those this patient needs.

voice.text: Order the tests this patient needs, and only those.
voice.example: Please order the tests this patient needs.

entries.explanation: Needed tests only: extra tests are not free.

entries.label: The results are opened

how_to.menu: Results tab: View a result, for every result you ordered.

voice.text: Open every result you ordered and read it.
voice.example: Show me the results I ordered.

entries.explanation: An ordered result is only useful once it is read.

entries.label: Senior called now

how_to.menu: Handover tab: Escalate (SBAR) to the senior doctor now.

voice.text: A rigid, board-like abdomen is an emergency: call the senior now.
voice.example: I am calling the senior doctor now.

entries.explanation: An emergency finding needs a senior at once.

how_to.menu: Admission tab: Introduce yourself, then Read wristband (tablet).

voice.text: Admission tab: Introduce yourself, then Read wristband (tablet).
voice.example: Hello, I am the doctor looking after you today.

entries.explanation: A calm start sets up the identity check.

how_to.menu: Admission tab: identity and allergy checks.

entries.explanation: Identity and allergy checks come before everything else.
